external_research.source: Puli, Zhang, Wald, Ranganath, Don't blame Dataset Shift! Shortcut Learning due to Gradients and Cross Entropy, NeurIPS 2023
external_research.observed_result: In the studied setting, default cross-entropy ERM can prefer shortcut dependence even when a stable feature perfectly determines the label and the shortcut adds no additional label information in the training distribution; the paper connects this to implicit max-margin bias and studies margin-control alternatives.
external_research.project_implication: Counterbalanced data, low nuisance MI and a nuisance-only decoder are necessary but not sufficient evidence that the learned Qwen3.5 mechanism is shortcut-free. This paper does not establish the same optimizer mechanism in Qwen3.5 and does not authorize a loss-function change.

external_research.source: Hong, Papanikolaou, Parbhoo, Do Regularization Methods for Shortcut Mitigation Work As Intended?, AISTATS 2025
external_research.observed_result: Shortcut-mitigation regularization can overregularize and suppress causal features along with spurious ones; mitigation success depends on conditions and must be evaluated.
external_research.project_implication: Any future optimizer/loss/regularization intervention requires causal-channel and retention validation; a mitigation-method label itself mints no semantic or training credit.

external_research.source: Kobayashi et al., When can transformers compositionally generalize in-context?, arXiv:2407.12275
external_research.observed_result: In a controlled modular multitask setting, transformers struggled to generalize to unseen task compositions until an explicit bottleneck separated task inference from task execution.
external_research.project_implication: Supports a matched diagnostic of process/state inference versus process execution in the EntityOS training program, but does not prove that one fixed decomposition is correct for Qwen3.5 or the recurrent variable-N system.

three_cycle_fusion.observe: Current Trigger-2 already contains deterministic semantic/order references plus strong data-level nuisance, provenance, state-history and causal-actionability controls, while positive data remains blocked by exact executable evidence.
three_cycle_fusion.hypothesis: The gate stack can still falsely infer mechanism quality from a clean dataset because optimizer dynamics are a separate source of shortcut selection.
three_cycle_fusion.counterhypothesis: Once visible nuisances are fully crossed and family/provenance leakage is removed, optimization contributes no independent shortcut failure mode.
three_cycle_fusion.discriminator: After current P0 closure, evaluate shortcut-neutral matched pairs across preregistered checkpoints while holding rendered nuisance signatures fixed.

three_cycle_fusion.observe: Puli et al. supplies evidence that gradient/cross-entropy optimization can select shortcuts without shortcut label-information gain; Hong et al. supplies evidence that mitigation can damage causal features.
three_cycle_fusion.hypothesis: A Qwen3.5-0.8B cognitive substrate may enter or remain in a heuristic regime even when the training design is counterbalanced.
three_cycle_fusion.counterhypothesis: The actual Qwen3.5 architecture/data regime learns systematic process semantics without optimizer-specific failure.
three_cycle_fusion.discriminator: Track family-disjoint S3/order/history systematicity, nuisance-ablation robustness, READ/BIND_ROUTE/WRITE trajectories and mandatory retention floors across checkpoints/seeds before considering any optimizer change.

three_cycle_fusion.observe: The finished system requires unseen recombinations of planning, binding, DB-vs-simulation, Hyperposition and Claude handoff/re-entry rather than isolated local labels; Kobayashi et al. shows one controlled setting where explicit inference/execution separation enabled composition.
three_cycle_fusion.hypothesis: A typed process/state-inference -> bind/route -> execution/output bottleneck can improve recombination of Zero/EntityOS cognitive functions.
three_cycle_fusion.counterhypothesis: Over-factorization yields locally correct subskills that do not compose in the recurrent loop or creates a new intermediate-serialization shortcut.
three_cycle_fusion.discriminator: Matched family-disjoint pilot comparing factorized versus less-factorized supervision on identical end-to-end recurrent tasks, with carrier serialization counterbalance, variable-N nuisance control, per-channel retention floors and final-loop success.

optimizer_shortcut_mechanism_gate_v1.promotion_rule: Data-level nuisance PASS is necessary but not sufficient; require reproducible late-checkpoint systematic behavior on shortcut-neutral families without mandatory-channel retention collapse.
optimizer_shortcut_mechanism_gate_v1.non_rule: Do not infer from the cited cross-domain literature that cross-entropy, margin control or regularization is intrinsically good or bad for Qwen3.5.

composition_bottleneck_diagnostic_v1.promotion_rule: Intermediate/process supervision counts only if it improves unseen composition and recurrent-loop success without becoming a presentation shortcut.
